SELECT r.fiscal_period_label, r.period_start_date, r.period_end_date, r.fully_loaded,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN r.period_start_date - 7 AND r.period_end_date + 7) AS web_lines,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN r.period_start_date - 7 AND r.period_end_date + 7 GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_keys
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar r WHERE r.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND r.fiscal_period IN (9,10)

WITH web AS (
  SELECT o.web_order_id, o.status, o.fulfilment_type,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order o
),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, w.status, w.fulfilment_type, w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date, s.store_id, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 OR f.channel_code='WB' OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, l.store_id, l.status, l.fulfilment_type, l.category='ZZ Test' AS test, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT l.sales_line_id) ids, SUM(l.net_amount) net
FROM lines l LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=COALESCE(l.dispatch_date,l.sale_date)
WHERE COALESCE(l.dispatch_date,l.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5,6

SELECT d.fiscal_period, rs.store_id AS return_store, w.fulfilment_type, (ss.store_id=900) AS orig_web, p.category='ZZ Test' AS test,
  COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) ids, SUM(r.refund_net) refund_net, SUM(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
LEFT JOIN dim_store ss ON ss.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-02-22'
  AND (rs.store_id=900 OR ss.store_id=900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH web_order AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, w.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_order w   ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, w.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN web_order w   ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS period,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN n.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END), 2) AS cc_net,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS web_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS click_collect_share_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2

FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=c.business_date
WHERE c.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
